note: Points for the game's horror and sound design. Unity prefab space (parked: the root is pitched nose-up 9.98 deg, ground points sit on the parked ground). Scare sockets: +Z = where the figure looks; Socket_Scare_Window_*: the face point 0.35 m outside the pane, looking in; the others: feet. Audio sockets: emitters (identity rotation).

Socket_Scare_Bay_Aft.note: bay floor at the rear bulkhead, facing the cockpit

Socket_Scare_Bay_Fwd.note: bay floor right behind the cargo barrier, facing the crew

Socket_Scare_Window_Pilot_L.note: face point outside the window, looking in

Socket_Scare_Window_Pilot_R.note: face point outside the window, looking in

Socket_Scare_Window_Side_L.note: face point outside the window, looking in

Socket_Scare_Window_Side_R.note: face point outside the window, looking in

Socket_Scare_Window_Cargo_L.note: face point outside the window, looking in

Socket_Scare_Window_Cargo_R.note: face point outside the window, looking in

Socket_Scare_Window_Aft_L.note: face point outside the window, looking in

Socket_Scare_Window_Aft_R.note: face point outside the window, looking in

Socket_Scare_Windshield.note: face point on the cowling in front of the windshield, looking at the crew

Socket_Scare_Nose.note: ground 2.6 m ahead of the propeller

Socket_Scare_UnderWing_L.note: ground under the wing, facing the fuselage

Socket_Scare_UnderWing_R.note: ground under the wing, facing the fuselage

Socket_Audio_Radio.note: cabin speaker under the overhead console (radio voices)

Socket_Audio_Headset_P.note: pilot headset hanging behind the seat (whispers)

Socket_Audio_Headset_C.note: right headset hanging behind the seat

Socket_Audio_StallHorn.note: stall warning horn, upper left corner of the windshield

Socket_Audio_Roof.note: on top of the wing centre section (steps)

Socket_Audio_ELT.note: emergency locator transmitter in the tail cone

alsoUseful: Socket_Seat_Pax* (a figure sitting in a bay seat)
fogPrints: UtilityPlaneRig.StampFogPrint(worldPoint, brush, sizeM, angleDeg, wipe, strength): a hand / finger print on the fogged glass; StampFogStroke(a, b, width) writes; ClearFogPrints() cleans.
